description:
Resolve one Rivet Actor and return its id, name, key, status, region, and inspector capabilities, with an embedded Inspector on MCP Apps hosts. Read-only. To find an actor id first, use the execute tool with rivet.actors.names.list() and rivet.actors.list().
This server is fixed to one organization, project, and namespace. Do not pass organization, project, or namespace; naming a different level is refused.

actorId.description: Existing actor id, as returned by rivet.actors.list

key.description: Actor key parts: an array of strings, or a single string for a one-part key

namespace.description: Rivet namespace this call acts on

organization.description: Rivet organization slug this call acts on

project.description: Rivet project slug this call acts on

name: rivet.actor.inspect
